items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think after old man George Moretti. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. That's right. You know George Moretti.

ctx.x: But he led the Onward for a while on trumpet, you know. That's right. I think after old man George Moretti.
That's right. That's right. You know George Moretti.
I heard about him. I wondered if Wooden Joe ever had a brass band. You remember Wooden Joe?
